summary.text: Mark Johnson is a Republican state representative from Chillicothe who has represented Ohio House District 92 since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business manager of the Tri-State Building and Construction Trades Council and construction superintendent.

paragraphs.text: Johnson succeeded Gary Scherer in District 92 and defeated Democrat Arthur Beatty in the November 5, 2024 general election.
He chairs the Commerce and Labor Committee and also serves on Development, Finance and Natural Resources.
Sarah Senff is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
